Maya (People Ops): Heads up: we've pushed a small handbook update covering bereavement definitions, part-time parental leave clarification, and the updated flexible work request flow. Please review before next Wed. Mandatory short training (15m) due Jul 7. Tracker link in the sheet.

Evan (Comp & Benefits): Link?

Maya (People Ops): https://confluence.redwood.ai/handbook/jul-2026-sprint and tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/handbook-jul-2026

Lina (Legal): Reviewed and clarified the bereavement bullet points. Replaced "immediate family" with a clear list. Added jurisdiction note for EU employees.

Tom (Eng Manager): Managers need a script for talking to ICs about phased return after parental leave. Is that in the sheet?

Maya (People Ops): Yes 1 under "Manager notes". Also added a quick FAQ for contractor conversions.

Evan (Comp & Benefits): Enrollment window extended to 45 days for conversions; noted in benefits section.

Tom (Eng Manager): Can managers bulk-acknowledge training completion?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, but please verify before marking. We'll random audit ~10% of teams.

notifier-bot: Reminder scheduled: all employees will receive training nudge Jul 1 and Jul 5 (status: queued).

Lina (Legal): I'll add a short blurb for offers to be updated by Recruiting.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks. Office hours Thurs 11:00 for managers. Add requests to the tracker or reply here.
__notes: Slack thread about handbook edits, manager notes, compliance training schedule. Messages are chronological and prefixed by sender names.
